blog.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
blog.faq.subtitle: About the Research Logbook
blog.faq.a1: There is no fixed frequency. Articles are published when the analysis is mature enough to share. Quality and technical rigor take priority over publication frequency.
blog.faq.a2: No. All blog content is for educational and informational purposes. It does not constitute financial, legal, or tax advice. Each reader is responsible for their own investment decisions.
blog.faq.q3: Can I suggest a topic to research?
blog.faq.a3: Yes. You can send research suggestions via Telegram (@zero0xlenador) or X (@0xlenador). Topics with the highest demand and technical interest are prioritized in the research pipeline.
blog.faq.q4: What types of content are published?
blog.faq.a4: Primarily in-depth technical analyses, tool guides, and documented investment theses. No buy/sell signals, news summaries, or superficial opinion content are published.
